mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_daily_report (report_date, created_count, completed_count, avg_accept_minutes, avg_finish_minutes, overdue_count, triage_done_count, triage_failed_count, generated_at, shard_total) SELECT #{day} AS report_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_work_order w WHERE w.created_at >= #{dayStart} AND w.created_at < #{dayEnd}) AS created_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_work_order_log l WHERE l.new_status = 'COMPLETED' AND l.created_at >= #{dayStart} AND l.created_at < #{dayEnd}) AS completed_count, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, w.created_at, l.created_at) / 60), 2) FROM t_work_order_log l JOIN t_work_order w ON w.id = l.order_id WHERE l.new_status = 'ACCEPTED' AND l.created_at >= #{dayStart} AND l.created_at < #{dayEnd}) AS avg_accept_minutes, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, w.created_at, l.created_at) / 60), 2) FROM t_work_order_log l JOIN t_work_order w ON w.id = l.order_id WHERE l.new_status = 'COMPLETED' AND l.created_at >= #{dayStart} AND l.created_at < #{dayEnd}) AS avg_finish_minutes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_work_order w WHERE w.created_at < #{dayEnd} AND w.sla_deadline IS NOT NULL AND w.sla_deadline < #{dayEnd} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_work_order_log l WHERE l.order_id = w.id AND l.new_status = 'COMPLETED' AND l.created_at < #{dayEnd})) AS overdue_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_work_order w WHERE w.created_at >= #{dayStart} AND w.created_at < #{dayEnd} AND w.triage_status = 'DONE') AS triage_done_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_work_order w WHERE w.created_at >= #{dayStart} AND w.created_at < #{dayEnd} AND w.triage_status = 'FAILED') AS triage_failed_count, NOW() AS generated_at, #{shardTotal} AS shard_total ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE created_count = VALUES(created_count), completed_count = VALUES(completed_count), avg_accept_minutes = VALUES(avg_accept_minutes), avg_finish_minutes = VALUES(avg_finish_minutes), overdue_count = VALUES(overdue_count), triage_done_count = VALUES(triage_done_count), triage_failed_count = VALUES(triage_failed_count), generated_at = VALUES(generated_at), shard_total = VALUES(shard_total)

INSERT INTO t_daily_report_part (report_date, shard_index, shard_total, created_count, completed_count, overdue_count, triage_done_count, triage_failed_count, generated_at) SELECT #{day} AS report_date, #{shardIndex} AS shard_index, #{shardTotal} AS shard_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_work_order w WHERE w.created_at >= #{dayStart} AND w.created_at < #{dayEnd} AND MOD(w.id, #{shardTotal}) = #{shardIndex}) AS created_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_work_order_log l WHERE l.new_status = 'COMPLETED' AND l.created_at >= #{dayStart} AND l.created_at < #{dayEnd} AND MOD(l.order_id, #{shardTotal}) = #{shardIndex}) AS completed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_work_order w WHERE w.created_at < #{dayEnd} AND w.sla_deadline IS NOT NULL AND w.sla_deadline < #{dayEnd} AND MOD(w.id, #{shardTotal}) = #{shardIndex} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_work_order_log l WHERE l.order_id = w.id AND l.new_status = 'COMPLETED' AND l.created_at < #{dayEnd})) AS overdue_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_work_order w WHERE w.created_at >= #{dayStart} AND w.created_at < #{dayEnd} AND w.triage_status = 'DONE' AND MOD(w.id, #{shardTotal}) = #{shardIndex}) AS triage_done_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_work_order w WHERE w.created_at >= #{dayStart} AND w.created_at < #{dayEnd} AND w.triage_status = 'FAILED' AND MOD(w.id, #{shardTotal}) = #{shardIndex}) AS triage_failed_count, NOW() AS generated_at ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE shard_total = VALUES(shard_total), created_count = VALUES(created_count), completed_count = VALUES(completed_count), overdue_count = VALUES(overdue_count), triage_done_count = VALUES(triage_done_count), triage_failed_count = VALUES(triage_failed_count), generated_at = VALUES(generated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS parts, COUNT(DISTINCT shard_index) AS distinctIndexes, COUNT(DISTINCT shard_total) AS distinctTotals, IFNULL(MIN(shard_total), 0) AS minTotal FROM t_daily_report_part WHERE report_date = #{day}
SELECT watermark_date FROM t_job_watermark WHERE job_key = #{jobKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_job_watermark (job_key, watermark_date, updated_at) VALUES (#{jobKey}, #{day}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE watermark_date = VALUES(watermark_date), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_daily_report WHERE report_date = #{day}
